verdict.rationale: Skyfire does have its own discovery surface. The MCP server's "find-sellers" tool and the Directory let agents discover services programmatically, and sellers attach pricing when they create a service, so some price-bearing listing data is plausibly exposed. However, no documented response schema shows which offer fields come back. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable price fields in discovery responses, availability data, variants, checkout links, coverage of arbitrary products (not just approved Skyfire services), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
